cold_open.hook: Eli Lilly up 6.2% on Zepbound sales that are basically printing money, but AMD just tanked 5% despite beating earnings—the market's officially broken.

markets.macro_note: Breadth weak despite index gains; VIX creeping up as rate-cut expectations fade.

big_story.story_title: AMD sinks 5% despite earnings beat, strong data center revenue
big_story.angle: AMD crushed guidance and data center revenue but the stock got punished anyway—the real story is that investors are pricing in a slowdown in AI capex, not AMD's actual performance.

quick_hits.angle: Eli Lilly's Zepbound and Mounjaro are now the company's growth engine; obesity drug revenue is outpacing traditional pharma and forcing a complete portfolio rebalance.
SpaceX's satellite internet is now a direct threat to telecom incumbents—Starlink's coverage map is becoming the real competitive moat, not the rockets.
Uber's bookings miss signals demand is cooling faster than the company expected; third-quarter guidance is the canary in the coal mine for consumer spending.
Disney's parks and streaming both firing on cylinders—the real win is that streaming is finally profitable enough to matter, not just a loss-leader.

odd_thing.joke_angle: Elon one-upping his own execs on the earnings call is peak founder energy—like watching a CEO interrupt his CFO to explain why his company is better than his company.

yesterday_callback.topic: Caterpillar's data-center demand story and what's NOT in those factories
yesterday_callback.fresh_take: AMD's miss-despite-beat today proves the data-center capex cycle is already cooling—Caterpillar's 500-point Dow bump yesterday was the peak of the hype, not the start of a new leg.

sign_off.callback_target: AMD's earnings beat that nobody cared about
